svg.title: Multi-scale speaker embedding windows
svg.desc: NeMo cuts each speech region into overlapping windows at six scales, from 3.0 seconds with a 1.5 second shift down to 0.5 seconds with a 0.25 second shift, and computes one TitaNet embedding per window. Shown for the first 16 seconds of the public VoxConverse clip aepyx, with the human speaker turns on top.
svg.text: Six window scales, one TitaNet embedding per window
